help.tab_cleaner_html:
🧹 Cleaner Workspace & Manual Brush

The CLEANER category provides two complementary ways to clean pages:

1. AI Inpainting Mask (Red / Cyan Overlay)

  • Use OCR SCAN [O] or TRANSPARENCY SCAN [T] to automatically highlight text or transparent regions, or paint masks manually with BRUSH, RECT, LASSO, POLY, and BUCKET.
  • Hold [Alt] with any mask tool to erase mask areas (shown in Cyan).
  • Press EXECUTE CLEAN [C] to run LaMa AI inpainting on the masked regions.

2. Manual Cleaner Brush (MANUAL [D] & PICKER [I])

  • Designed for quick touch-ups inside flat speech bubbles or backgrounds where AI is unnecessary.
  • Click MANUAL to reveal the contextual color bar containing PICKER [I], the Color Swatch, and the quick White reset button.
  • While in MANUAL mode, hold [Alt] + Left-Click anywhere on the canvas to sample a color on the fly.
  • Pressing Ctrl + Z while in Manual mode safely undoes your painted image strokes without losing your work.
help.tab_hardware_html:
💻 System Diagnostics & Performance

Compute Engine Found: {engine}

System RAM Detected: {ram} GB

Memory & GPU Optimizations

  • VRAM Tiling: AI Inpainting processes patches in configurable chunks (Max Tile Size slider) to prevent GPU out-of-memory crashes on high-resolution webtoons.
  • Model Persistence: During batch operations, ONNX/CUDA models remain warm in memory to maximize throughput.
  • Lazy Script Queue: Importing .txt translation scripts across 100+ pages stores only lightweight UTF-8 strings in memory until each page is actively opened.

help.tab_stitch_batch_html:
🧩 Lossless Image Stitcher & Batch Processing

1. Lossless Vertical Stitcher (STITCHER Workspace)

Combines multiple manga/webtoon pages vertically without visible seams or compression artifacts—ideal when platforms enforce strict file count limits (e.g., reducing 150 pages into 100 files).

  • Manual Blocks: Check specific files in Project Assets or pick a page range (From # ➔ To #) to build custom multi-page strips.
  • Auto: Pages per Output File: Automatically groups every N consecutive pages into one output file.
  • Auto: Fit to Max File Count: Automatically distributes all project pages to fit within your target file limit.
  • Height Guard & Lossless Export: Optional maximum pixel height splitter (can sync to 4x Max Tile Size) and lossless export in PNG or 100% Quality 4:4:4 JPG (including all active cleanings and typeset layers).

2. Automated Batch Processing (RUN BATCH PROCESS)

  1. Import a folder of pages (check specific files, or leave unchecked to process all).
  2. Click RUN BATCH PROCESS and select your Scan Mode (none, Mask, OCR Scan, Transparency Scan) and Export Format (none, png, jpg, photoshop, photopea).
  3. Cleaned and typesetted pages are saved to the /processed/ directory.
  4. Safety Check: Before exporting, batching, or stitching, the studio warns you if any page still has unplaced [ + ] script dialogues in the queue.
help.tab_translator_html:
📄 Translator Script Generator & Lazy-Queue Importer

The TRANSLATOR category streamlines teamwork between translators and typesetters using lightweight .txt files and shared project directories.

1. Shared 'translations/' Workspace Hierarchy

  • Shared Ecosystem: Automatically reads and organizes scripts inside the root translations/ folder, fully compatible with Manga Translate Studio.
  • Series & Script Pickers: Group scripts by series subfolders (📂), create new series folders on the fly with [➕], or open the folder in your operating system with [📁].
  • Dual Import Options: Load a selected script directly via Import Selected, or use Browse .TXT... to load a file from any location on your drive.
  • Unload Script from Memory: Click 🗑️ Unload Script from Memory to safely wipe queued [ + ] dialogues across all loaded pages without touching placed canvas text or resetting your in-memory project.

2. Script Formatting Rules

  • Strict Tag Isolation: Only text inside <translation> ... </translation> is parsed. Any notes, metadata, or # comments outside the tags are 100% ignored.
  • Dialogue Bullets: Each - line represents one text box. Empty - lines are automatically skipped.
  • Manual Line Breaks: Use // inside a line to force a line break within the same text box.
  • Unicode Ready: Full NFC normalization ensures filenames and dialogues in Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Russian, Arabic, and Spanish match reliably across Windows, Linux, and macOS.

3. Zero-RAM Lazy Queue Workflow ([ + ] ➔ [ ✓ ])

  • Importing a script queues dialogues into PAGE TEXT LAYERS as [ + ] items with 0 MB extra RAM usage.
  • In TYPESETTER, select your desired font/stroke first, then click the canvas to place the next queued line. Select a [ + ] line and click REMOVE QUEUED to discard it, or click NEW TEXT to create an independent text box.
  • Deleting a script-spawned text box or clicking CLEAR ALL safely returns those lines back to the [ + ] queue.
help.tab_typesetter_html:
🔤 Typesetter & Font Manager

Switch to the TYPESETTER category (or press [X]) to access a dedicated, clutter-free typesetting studio.

1. Font Manager, Favorites & Aliases

  • Search & Filter: Filter system fonts by name or custom alias in real time.
  • ★ Only: Toggle to display only your favorite scanlation fonts. This state and your last used font are automatically saved in font_presets.json.
  • Favorite (★) & Rename Alias (✎): Assign custom use-case names (e.g., ★ Shout [Wild Words]) while keeping the real font family visible in brackets.

2. Interactive Transform Gizmo

  • Smooth Center-Locked Scaling: Corner handles scale font size proportionally with stabilized sensitivity without drifting away from the dialogue bubble.
  • Cyan Side Handles (L / R): Drag horizontally to set a fixed word-wrap width aligned with the text's active rotation. Click Fit Box to reset to auto-width.
  • Top Cyan Circle: Drag to rotate text freely around its fixed center (hold Shift to snap to 15° angles, or click 0° to reset).

3. Outer Stroke & Page Text Layers

  • Click the Fill or Stroke color swatches to pick colors, or click ⇄ to swap them in one click.
  • Toggle Mode: Stroke (Outside) to enable a clean vector outer outline with adjustable pixel Size and Opacity.
  • PAGE TEXT LAYERS & Show Outlines: Lists all placed boxes ([ ✓ ]) and queued script lines ([ + ]).
  • Show Outlines Checkbox: Enable to display bright cyan dashed borders with a dark outline around unselected text boxes, keeping them visible on both light and dark artwork; uncheck for an instant, clean preview of the final page.
